title: About
heading: I stay close to
bioParagraphs: I'm Lee Gordon, a product designer with more than 15 years of experience. I've worked at agencies including R/GA and DigitasLBi, in-house at Nokia and Covetrus, and most recently led design at Fold.

I move between research, product strategy, interface design, design systems, and code. The job changes with the problem. Sometimes the right artifact is a journey map. Sometimes it is a working prototype that exposes what the team still does not understand.

My current work is about agentic interfaces: products that can plan, act, and make decisions. I care about where people stay in control, how the system explains itself, and what happens when it gets something wrong.

timeline.description: Designing agentic products and helping small teams turn rough technical demos into clear, testable product experiences.
Led product design for Fold's Bitcoin rewards app, built its design system, and established a regular user-research practice.
Planned and ran UX research to help product teams understand user needs and make better product decisions.
Designed products and brand systems that made Lightning Network tools easier to understand and operate.
Directed UX for Nokia's connected-home platform, including device setup, monitoring, and multi-user household controls.
Led digital product work for enterprise clients, including Qantas.
Designed connected products and digital services for clients including Nike and Verizon.
Designed digital products and brand identities for a mix of new and established companies.
Started my career designing digital work for clients including Nike and Verizon.
